{{Top|leg}}
'''Deamos Na-Coth''' was a former [[Slavery/Legends|slave]], [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]], [[General/Legends|general]], [[Author/Legends|writer]], [[Philosopher/Legends|philosopher]] and dreamer of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He believed in the existence of a [[Planet/Legends|world]] called [[Exo (planet)|Exo]], and was hailed as a [[Prophet/Legends|prophet]]. Na-Coth founded a series of explorations beyond the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] known as [[The Cabal (expedition)|The Cabal]] to search for Exo.
